description: Catalogue of place/POI data sources for the edot suite. Each entry carries enough to pull the data when/where needed: how it is reached (live api or an in-repo extract), its licence and attribution, what it returns, and — for extracts — where the file lives and how big it is. The provider code that uses a source is in js/providers/<provider>.js and is lazy-loaded by js/places.js only when that source is queried.

sources.name: Wikidata entity search
sources.notes: wbsearchentities gives name + QID + description, no coordinates; coordsFor(qid) pulls P625 lazily on selection. CORS via origin=*, no key.

sources.name: GeoNames gazetteer

config.username: required — free account at geonames.org; without it this source is a no-op

sources.notes: Coordinates + admin context + timezones, but no QIDs — the facade fuses these with a Wikidata QID hit for the same place.

sources.name: In-repo seed extract (UK sample)
sources.notes: Tiny baseline so the stack works offline / when APIs are blocked. Larger regional extracts ship gzipped via LFS (see the planned sources).

sources.name: Overture Maps — Places
sources.notes: The headline 'beyond OSM/Wikidata' source: POIs with names, categories, coordinates AND Wikidata QIDs. Clip a bbox offline to an LFS-cached extract; the same local provider then serves it.

sources.name: Foursquare Open Source Places
sources.notes: Dense venue coverage (no QIDs). Pair with Wikidata for QIDs where they exist.
